hints: Forget the ring for a moment. Walking left to right, what do you know about the readings whose answer you have not found yet?
They are in decreasing order - if an earlier one were smaller than a later one, the later one would have answered it. So the waiting readings form a decreasing stack.
Each new reading answers every waiting reading it exceeds, popping them, and then waits itself. Every reading is pushed once and popped once, so the whole pass is linear.
For the ring, walk the readings twice and only push during the first lap: the second lap answers whatever is still waiting without adding anyone new.
